title: Steam Game Reviews & Player Feedback Analyzer Input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Collect raw reviews, attach deterministic analysis, or compare before/after review windows around a patch.

steamAppIds.title: Steam app IDs
steamAppIds.description: One or more numeric Steam app IDs. Numeric strings are accepted by the runtime so the Console string-list editor can be used.

startUrls.title: Steam Store URLs
startUrls.description: Steam Store or community app URLs. App IDs are extracted and merged with steamAppIds.

url.title: Steam URL
url.description: Steam Store or community app URL.

languages.title: Review languages
languages.description: Steam language codes. Use all to request all languages.

reviewFilter.title: Review filter
reviewFilter.description: Return all reviews or only positive/negative recommendations.

purchaseType.title: Purchase type
purchaseType.description: Filter reviews by whether the reviewer purchased the game on Steam.

dateRange.title: Date range
dateRange.description: Optional inclusive date bounds and recent-days limit for review collection.

from.title: From
from.description: Inclusive ISO date lower bound. Leave blank to omit.

to.title: To
to.description: Inclusive ISO date upper bound. Leave blank to omit.

recentDays.title: Recent days
recentDays.description: Keep reviews from this many recent days. Use 0 to disable the recent-days bound.

maxReviewsPerGame.title: Maximum reviews per game
maxReviewsPerGame.description: Hard cap on reviews collected for each Steam app.

includeReviewText.title: Include review text
includeReviewText.description: Keep the original public review text in each output record.

analysis.title: Analysis settings
analysis.description: Settings reserved for the review-level analysis phase.

clusterSimilarIssues.title: Cluster similar issues
clusterSimilarIssues.description: Enable duplicate issue clustering in later phases.

aggregation.title: Aggregation settings
aggregation.description: Settings reserved for the per-game aggregation phase.

minimumClusterSize.title: Minimum cluster size
minimumClusterSize.description: Minimum mentions for a cluster in later phases.

includeExampleReviews.title: Include examples
includeExampleReviews.description: Include example review IDs in aggregate output.

maxExamplesPerTopic.title: Maximum examples per topic
maxExamplesPerTopic.description: Maximum example review IDs retained for a topic.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy settings for the collection layer.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Route supported collection requests through Apify Proxy.

releasedAt.title: Released at
releasedAt.description: Patch release time as an ISO date-time.

daysBefore.title: Days before patch
daysBefore.description: Number of days in the before window.

daysAfter.title: Days after patch
daysAfter.description: Number of days in the after window.

maxReviewsPerPeriod.title: Maximum reviews per period
maxReviewsPerPeriod.description: Hard cap for each patch comparison window.
